Question Choices: Select without calculating exactly, which is larger? ~~0.35x742 | 0.35x74.2~~
Hints: Multiplying two positive numbers preserves the order when one factor is common.
Solution: 742 > 74.2 and the common factor 0.35 is positive. Therefore 0.35×742 > 0.35×74.2. Also 742 is 10 times 74.2, so the first product is 10 times the second.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "15 x 0.7 should be less than 15" ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Hints: A positive number multiplied by a positive fraction below one becomes smaller.
Solution: 15 = 15/1; 0.7 = 7/10. Multiply: 15 × 7 = 105; denominator 1 × 10 = 10. So 15 × 0.7 = 105/10 = 10.5. Therefore the requested answer is TRUE.
